scripts.build: (cd packages/ui && bun run build) && bunx tsc --ignoreConfig --jsx react-jsx --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --lib es2022,dom,dom.iterable --types react,react-dom,vitest/globals,node --noEmit apps/desktop/src/lib/transport.ts apps/desktop/src/lib/transport.test.ts apps/desktop/vite-plugin-tauri-dev-bridge.ts apps/desktop/vite.config.ts apps/desktop/vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint: if rg -n '^import .*(@tauri-apps/api|.*apps/desktop|.*crates/daemon|.*supabase|.*transport)' packages/ui; then exit 1; fi
scripts.test: (cd packages/ui && bun run test) && bunx vitest run apps/desktop/src/lib/transport.test.ts
